final_boundary_requirements.title: Graceful Shutdown and Power Loss State Recovery
final_boundary_requirements.description: The export pipeline must handle sudden termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) and power loss events by flushing in-flight buffers, rolling back uncommitted source extraction transactions, and persisting execution cursors to ensure at-least-once or exactly-once processing without duplicate ingestion or data corruption.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: Ensures system resilience and prevents partial data writes or state loss during abrupt infrastructure scaling or maintenance cycles.

final_boundary_requirements.title: Statutory Cryptographic In Transit and At Rest Boundary
final_boundary_requirements.description: All data in transit across pipeline components and at rest in staging or dead-letter queues must be encrypted using FIPS 140-2/3 validated cryptographic modules to maintain HIPAA Security Rule compliance.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: Statutory mandate requiring technical safeguards for protected health information (PHI) regardless of pipeline deployment architecture.

final_boundary_requirements.title: Unstated Cryptographic Tokenization Provider
final_boundary_requirements.description: The specific identity provider, hashing salt rotation mechanism, or cryptographic tokenization engine used for pseudonymization or pseudonym mapping storage remains unstated.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: The prompt does not specify how persistent pseudonyms or reversible/irreversible token maps are managed across pipeline runs.

final_boundary_requirements.title: Unstated Network Transport and Messaging Protocol
final_boundary_requirements.description: The underlying message broker, streaming framework (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis), or RPC protocol used between pipeline stages remains unstated.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: No explicit architecture or transport protocol was mandated in the original prompt.
